name: Lavender
description: A beloved aromatic shrub with silver-gray foliage and tall floral spikes prized for their calming fragrance and essential oils.
use: Scent for the wardrobe, a feast for bees. Also used in herbal tea blends, baked goods, and syrups.
tips: Needs sandy or gravelly, lean soil with full sun. Do not add heavy fertilizers, and prune back in early spring above woody stems.
